name: work-map
description: A live, draggable map of what Claude is doing, in your browser: the main agent, its tools and its subagents, each with its model (based on alexeyw/lot-map, MIT)

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the labels on the map.

coreName.title: Name at the centre
coreName.description: What the circle in the middle of the map says, up to ten characters.

memoryServers.title: Memory servers
memoryServers.description: MCP servers whose tools light the Memory station.

memoryCommands.title: Memory commands
memoryCommands.description: Shell commands or scripts that light the Memory station. A name counts when it is the command itself or begins with it and a hyphen, an underscore or a dot.

memorySubcommands.title: Memory subcommands
memorySubcommands.description: Words after a memory command that the map may show, such as add or search. Without them a memory command goes by its own name, because the word after it may be content.

memoryPaths.title: Memory paths
memoryPaths.description: Parts of a path that make a file a memory. Claude Code's own memory folder always counts.

memoryLabels.title: Memory labels
memoryLabels.description: Short names for memory tools, each written as tool=name. A tool without one goes by its own name.

hookRecords.title: Hooks add numbered records
hookRecords.description: Turn on if a hook of yours adds memory records numbered like [#123]: the map then shows them on the Memory station, by number only. It counts such numbers in the text of any hook, not only a memory one.

hookReasons.title: Show why a hook refused
hookReasons.description: Show the first line of a hook's refusal, up to 72 characters. Off, the map says only which tool was stopped: a refusal may quote what the hook found.
